title: Crash fallback conflicts with the verified customer date and time
context: Rivet is the delivery coordination desk. Use the stated owners and restrictions in this case. All times UTC. Actions use sandbox messages.
initial_request: Recover DL-8400 after its van became unavailable while respecting the current verified recipient requirements.

events.body: DL-8400 was due today, 10 October, 10:00–12:00 UTC. Its van crashed. The driver reports nobody was injured, and the van is unavailable. Replacement capacity is confirmed for Sunday 11 October 10:00–12:00 UTC only. This is an offer, not a booking.
I cannot receive DL-8400 on Sunday morning. Sunday 11 October 14:00–16:00 UTC works, or Monday 12 October 10:00–12:00 UTC. Please check those times instead. This is my verified account.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Dispatch for feasible Sunday afternoon or Monday morning options matching the verified customer request; do not book the Sunday morning fallback.

must: Requests carrier capacity matching Sunday 11 October 14:00–16:00 or Monday 12 October 10:00–12:00 UTC
Preserves the verified customer availability instead of accepting the Sunday morning fallback
must_not: Requests a booking for Sunday 10:00–12:00, which the customer rejected
Promises or reports a booking or arrival that has not been confirmed
Asks the customer to repeat the date/time choice already provided
Escalates solely because the van is unavailable or the offered slot conflicts with customer availability
Introduces a goods-safety release hold before any evidence identifies an applicable goods-safety restriction

rationale: Ask Dispatch for feasible Sunday afternoon or Monday morning options matching the verified customer request; do not book the Sunday morning fallback.
